meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能按你的要求操作浏览器:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取网页数据等;页面状态会保留,可分多步陆续完成,也能连接你已登录的 Chrome 浏览器继续操作。
howto.when: 当你提到打开网址、点击、填表等关键词,或要求截图、抓取数据、自动化操作浏览器时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截个图给我看
say.note: Claude 会新建页面并返回截图。

say.text: 点击页面上那个“登录”按钮
say.note: 会先读取页面元素再点击。

say.text: 把当前网页的所有文章标题抓下来
say.note: 会提取页面里的标题列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate a browser on request: open URLs, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, and more. Page state is kept between steps so multi-step tasks work, and it can attach to your logged-in Chrome in extension mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to open a URL, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, log in, test a site, or automate browser workflows.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot for me.
say_en.note: Claude creates a page and returns the screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the 'Login' button on this page.
say_en.note: It reads the page elements first, then clicks.

say_en.text: Scrape all article titles from this page.
say_en.note: It extracts the title list from the page.
